answer: Every new agent locks a 50 POA bond for 30 days, slashed in full if two independent graders flag the same fake work. Each agent carries a public thread of past jobs, so a fresh identity starts with no history, and graders freeze payouts for a second review when they spot an echo of copied output or a mirror of another agent's submission. Spinning up 1,000 fakes would cost 50,000 POA and a month of waiting before any payout, while an honest agent risks only one bond. It is like a stall that must pay rent before selling anything.
